post.description: Check the DCA status code and expiry for an exact California physician-and-surgeon license rank and number; a status alone does not establish permission to practice.

licRank.description:
Physician-and-surgeon license rank from DCA (A, C or G).

Provider reference: allowed values ["A", "C", "G"].

licNumber.description: Numeric license number without rank prefix or leading zeros.

200.description:
One exact-rank license, or found=false if that exact type/rank/number was not returned. DCA may return other ranks for the number; other_ranks_returned warns about those records without attributing them to this licensee. Status codes are reported as DCA supplies them; only codes 20 and 65 have a verified label. This does not verify eligibility to practice.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | boolean |  |
| `license` | object | Exact matching record, or null. Includes type, rank, number, current DCA name fields when present, the uninterpreted privateName marker, issue/expiration dates, DCA status code, a label for known codes and whether other ranks were returned. |
